question: Also, how many volumes do you expect there will be by the time Re:Zero is complete?
answer:
If you simply calculate it, it'll be around 35 or 36 volumes, but if it reaches 37 volumes, that'll be the same number of volumes as Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai, so I'll aim for that.

Note: As of today (22 Sept 2026), we have 44 Volumes and has only started Arc 10
